messages:
Maya R (Marketing): morning async — quick state for the Campaign Orion push. what i shipped yesterday: final copy for benchmark post, short-form snippets for socials, uploaded hero draft to drive. blockers: need the demo iframe to show live latency numbers and a 1200x630 hero JPG from design. today: coordinate with eng for embed, finalize hashtags, send to legal for quick check.
Tom H (Eng): got it — i reviewed the embed API yesterday, small change needed to CORS headers. i'll try to get a hotfix out today. PR #4523 is up for review. can someone add the exact iframe size requirements in the PR description?
Lena D (Design): noted — exporting hero JPG now. will drop two variants (1200x630 and 800x418) in the campaign folder in ~30m. added a light and dark option.
Raj P (Growth): thumbs up. i can schedule the benchmark post for 10am PT tomorrow if embed is ready by EOD. also can we run a test preview link on staging for review?
Tom H (Eng): yes staging preview possible. @Maya R, put the staging url in the PR comment and i'll attach a signed URL for the iframe. also leaving a TODO in #4523: update the cache TTL to 10s for demo mode.
Maya R (Marketing): adding sizes and staging link to the PR now. thanks @Lena D. legal pinged (short turn), alex will coordinate copy updates.
Alex C (Content): quick note — i'm trimming the first paragraph to 2 lines for SEO preview. dropping the trimmed version into the doc now: "Redwood Inference cuts inference costs with smart batching — here’s how we measured latency at scale."
Tom H (Eng): quick heads-up: if we toggle demo to include KV cache metrics the payload increases. recommend enabling `?mode=minimal` by default. snippet for embed (copy into PR):
```html
<iframe src="https://staging.redwood.inference/embed/campaign-orion?mode=minimal" width="1200" height="630" frameborder="0" allow="clipboard"></iframe>
```
Lena D (Design): pushed final JPGs to the drive folder: https://drive.redwood/drive/campaign-orion/assets (public link). used the darker hero for small screens.
Raj P (Growth): scheduling checklist: 1) assets in drive, 2) staging preview link in PR, 3) legal + content signoff, 4) embed smoke test. ping me when step 2 is ready and i'll start scheduling.
Maya R (Marketing): all items noted. @Tom H can you ping here once #4523 is merged so i can confirm the live embed? also if anyone spots a copy regression after design changes, flag it here.
Tom H (Eng): will do — aiming to merge by 5pm PT today. leaving a final QA note in the PR for image alt text and tweet-ready excerpt.
jen-bot: reminder — weekly campaign cadence sync in #marketing at 3pm PT today :calendar: (auto-reminder)
